sections.heading: Destination Snapshot
sections.body: Slovenia works best as a country-level sport-climbing gateway here, with the strongest practical focus on the southwest and the Osp/Mišja Peč circuit.
warnings: No sufficiently specific sourced content for Destination Snapshot.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Slovenia is too broad to behave like a single destination page. The strongest climbing detail points toward southwest Slovenia and the Adriatic-side sport crags, especially the Osp area and Mišja Peč.

For climbers, the useful frame is a regional circuit rather than a claim that the whole country has one style, one season or one logistics pattern.

sections.heading: Rock And Climbing Character
sections.body: The supported climbing style is sport climbing, with southwest Slovenia and the Osp-area crags as the strongest current focus. Expect limestone sport climbing, including steep and technical routes where the famous venues concentrate the harder climbing.

sections.heading: Who It Suits
sections.body: This entry suits climbers researching a Slovenia sport-climbing trip, but it needs narrowing before it can read like a finished destination guide. Specific crag pages for Osp, Mišja Peč or other areas would serve users better.
warnings: No sufficiently specific sourced content for Who It Suits.

sections.heading: Grades And Scale
sections.body: The southwest Slovenia and Osp-area circuit has more than 3,100 documented routes across 32 areas. That count should not be treated as a single-crag number.
